graphics: draws a picture: writes an image, or renders one in text
interactive: reads what the user types and responds to it
simulation: models a process step by step
sorting: a sorting algorithm, or ordering data
text-processing: reads, transforms or reports on text
maths: arithmetic, geometry, algebra or numerical methods
number-theory: properties of integers: divisors, digits, sequences
recursion: solved by a function calling itself
data-structures: builds or uses a data structure: lists, trees, stacks, queues, maps
algorithms: a named algorithm: search, graph, dynamic programming, and the like
puzzles: solves a puzzle or a riddle
parsing: parses a language, an expression or a format
concurrency: runs work concurrently: threads, tasks, synchronisation
basics: shows a single language basic: a loop, a literal, input or output
pattern-matching: matches values with case, if let or destructuring
generators: produces a lazy sequence with yield or stream
generics: declares a generic type or function
closures: builds functions from function literals that capture state
operators: defines operators on its own types
dotnet-interop: calls into .NET libraries beyond the ghūl runtime
